content.text:
I've fixed the CRLF bug in `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` (`packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts:72-75`), which I'm fairly confident is the cause of this issue.

**Cause:** Docusaurus unwraps ` ```mdx-code-block ` fences before compiling, so content commonly placed in them, like `import Tabs …` / `import TabItem …`, becomes real MDX. The patterns that find these blocks only matched `\n` line endings. In a CRLF file they never matched, so the imports stayed inside a code block and were never run. That gives exactly the error in the report: "Expected component `TabItem` to be defined".

**Fix:** Every `\n` in the 3- and 4-backtick patterns is now `\r?\n`, so the blocks are unwrapped with either line ending.

**What I checked:** I couldn't see the issue's screenshot of the Markdown, so I'm assuming the imports were inside an `mdx-code-block` fence. If they weren't, this change won't fix that case. I wrote a temporary CRLF test for the function and it passed, as did all the existing tests in `markdownUtils.test.ts`; I then deleted the temporary test. I didn't build a full site with a CRLF page.

The editor reported TypeScript errors in this file (`replaceAll` not available, implicit `any`). They point at lines I didn't change and look like an editor library-version setting rather than a real problem; the tests compiled and ran fine.
